title: Debts
intro: A debt is a record between you and a friend, confirmed on both phones.
stillValid: A change you sent stays valid if your friend confirms it later. It adds only that change.
clearPending: You can clear this debt once its payment is done.
repayNote: Your payment is sent only after your friend confirms it repays this debt.
orphaned: Made before this phone's identity was reset. Your friend's phone still has it.
settlingDetail: The debt goes down for good once the payment is credited.
recordHelp: Both phones show the same code when they agree.
signNote: Confirming records this on both phones. Buckspay only keeps the record; it doesn't lend or collect.
viaCode: Anyone who sees the code can read this debt.
synced: Your friend's phone had newer changes. Check the debt and try again.

refused.locked: This debt is being worked out with friends, or is waiting for a payment. Try again after it ends.
refused.stale: Your friend's phone has a newer version of this debt.
refused.other: You already have a debt with this person.
refused.invalid: This offer couldn't be checked. Nothing was confirmed.

notSigned: {{peer}} hasn't confirmed this yet. Send it again, or make a new change.
paymentFailed: This payment failed. The debt is back to {{amount}}.
settleBefore: Use this payment, or let it be credited, before {{date}} for the debt to go down.
